We’re not just an industry leader; we’re an industry pioneer. We are responsible for shaping the way
growers treat their crops. Our inventions have changed the face of agriculture and continue to help
farmers around the world precisely, efficiently treat their fields.

compatible with the Classic, Alpha, Omni, and Ultra Mister. Features nut drivers to tigthen and
loosen screw clamps and lockling clip release to help remove hoses from the Mister Mist’r or pump.

Bringing Relevant Information

VA 22201 **
* 
  # Irrigation Show registration is open!
  
  #### Save your spot early to lock in the lowest rates of the year.
  
  [REGISTER NOW][205]
* 
  # Join the conversation!
  
  #### Help promote the value of efficient irrigation by downloading ready-to-use
  #### social media resources, media outreach tools and more.
  
  [DOWNLOAD RESOURCES][206]
* 
  # Enter the New Product Contest
  
  #### Manufacturers can put their latest innovation on display at the Irrigation Show
  #### to gain exposure and industry recognition.
  
  [LEARN MORE][207]
* 
  # Expand your learning.
  
  #### IA Select classes are partner-provided, IA-approved courses delivering a great way to upgrade
  #### your skills and prepare for or maintain an IA certification.
  
  [EXPLORE COURSES][208]
* 
  # Stay sharp. Stay competitive.
  
  #### An IA certification adds instant credibility to your work and helps you
  #### stand out as the smart choice to current and potential customers.
  
  [GET CERTIFIED][209]

## Industry Insights

Check out our ag and landscape [webinar series][210] featuring knowledgeable experts presenting
information about today’s important trends, topics and best practices in the industry.

## Certification

[IA certification][211] gives you a competitive edge and helps you get ahead in the industry. Learn
how to add instant credibility and take your career to the next level by becoming IA-certified.

## IA Publications

[*Irrigation Today*][212] and [*Irrigation & Lighting*][213] magazines keep you up to date on the
latest trends, technologies and issues in both the agriculture and landscape irrigation industries.

## Irrigation Show

The irrigation industry is headed to Las Vegas for the [2026 Irrigation Show][214]. Join us to
explore, connect and learn as we blend inspiration and innovation with fun in The Entertainment
Capital of the World.

## News & Announcements

[Irrigation Association highlights industry voices and practical tools for Smart Irrigation
Month][215]
7/7/2026

The Irrigation Association will recognize July as Smart Irrigation Month, its annual initiative to
promote efficient irrigation practices and help industry professionals share that message with
customers and communities.

[Irrigation Association announces newly elected directors][216]
1/13/2026

The Irrigation Association is pleased to announce three new members of the IA Board of Directors.

[IA announces Startup of the Year Award winner at 2025 Irrigation Show][217]
12/11/2025

The Irrigation Association proudly announced the winner of its inaugural Startup of the Year Award
during the General Session at the 2025 Irrigation Show and Education Week.

## Industry Insights

Check out our ag and landscape [webinar series][210] featuring knowledgeable experts presenting
information about today’s important trends, topics and best practices in the industry.

## Certification

[IA certification][211] gives you a competitive edge and helps you get ahead in the industry. Learn
how to add instant credibility and take your career to the next level by becoming IA-certified.

## IA Publications

[*Irrigation Today*][212] and [*Irrigation & Lighting*][213] magazines keep you up to date on the
latest trends, technologies and issues in both the agriculture and landscape irrigation industries.

## Irrigation Show

The irrigation industry is headed to Las Vegas for the [2026 Irrigation Show][214]. Join us to
explore, connect and learn as we blend inspiration and innovation with fun in The Entertainment
Capital of the World.

## **By farmers, for farmers—More than 60 years of leading from the field**

For over 6 decades, Netafim has stood alongside farmers, empowering them to grow more with less.

What began in the desert, with the invention of drip irrigation, has grown into a global journey of
innovation in precision irrigation. By staying close to the field and working side by side with
growers around the world, we have continued to turn agronomic knowledge, innovation, and field
experience into practical solutions that help farmers reduce uncertainty, gain more control, and
grow with confidence.

# 60 Voices from the Field

### Celebrating 60 Years of Impact 

[ Hear their stories ][119]

Grow more with confidence

with precision irrigation 

[ Start growing smarter ][120]

[ Explore drip solutions ][121]

## **By farmers, for farmers—More than 60 years of leading from the field**

For over 6 decades, Netafim has stood alongside farmers, empowering them to grow more with less.

What began in the desert, with the invention of drip irrigation, has grown into a global journey of
innovation in precision irrigation. By staying close to the field and working side by side with
growers around the world, we have continued to turn agronomic knowledge, innovation, and field
experience into practical solutions that help farmers reduce uncertainty, gain more control, and
grow with confidence.

## **Making every drop count**

Precision irrigation gives farmers greater control over one of the most important resources in the
field: Water.

By delivering water and nutrients directly to the root zone, in the right amount and at the right
time, farmers can make every drop and every decision count. The result is more efficient use of
resources, stronger crop performance, and more confidence season after season.

 

[LEARN MORE][122]

## Crop knowledge sharing

To maximize both your yields and your long-term success, our agronomists work with you, offering
personalized support, guidance and best practices every step of the way. Whatever your challenges,
they’ll provide you with the most accurate, up-to-date global intelligence on how to use precision
irrigation to improve your yields and crop quality, based on over 50 years of experience.

fertilizer use efficiency. 

[Avocado]

### [ Avocado ][125]

Precision irrigation offers an increased avocado yield of up to 30% as well as super-fast ROI. Learn
how.

[Wine grapes]

### [ Wine grapes ][126]

Learn to control growth, boost grape quality, enhance your yield, and optimize your water-use
efficiency.

[ To all crops ][127]
[Digital farming]

## You’ll never turn a valve again

### **Monitor, analyze and optimize every stage of every plant’s lifecycle**

### Get more precise, automated control over every detail of your farm, and deeper insights into
### your crop health, soil conditions and yield performance – with support and guidance at every
### step. So it’s easier to run your farm and boost your profitability.

 

[Learn more][128]

## Sustainability means profitability

## Today, the best way to deliver bigger, better, more profitable yields is also the most

## populations and enable global prosperity with precision irrigation.

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

## AGCO. Where extraordinary grows.

Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do
for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work,
building a better and more sustainable world. Join us!

[ [AGCO - Your Agriculture Company - Red and white logo] ][99]
AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) is a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture
technologies.

Driven by a Farmer-First strategy, AGCO delivers value through its differentiated leading brands,
Fendt™, Massey Ferguson™, PTx™ and Valtra™.  AGCO’s high-performance equipment and smart farming
solutions, including brand-agnostic retrofit technologies and autonomous offerings, empower farmers
to drive productivity while sustainably feeding the world.

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them.

## Legacies of the Land

American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

## [Unveiling Agri Pipes: Pioneering the Drip Irrigation Revolution in Tirupattur][9]

[ admn.kadeshwar.groups@gmail.com ][10] / October 11, 2024

The Evolution of Drip Irrigation Technology Drip irrigation, a method that delivers water directly
to the plant’s roots, has undergone a remarkable transformation since its inception. Its origins can
be traced back to ancient civilizations such as the Mesopotamians and Egyptians, who utilized simple
devices to provide water to crops. However, it wasn’t until the 20th century that technological
advancements began to shape the modern drip irrigation system we recognize today. The first modern
adaptation of drip irrigation was developed in Israel in the 1960s, where researchers aimed to
enhance water efficiency in arid environments. As agriculture faced the challenges of water scarcity
and the necessity for increased crop yields, the adoption of drip irrigation spread globally. This
method has proven to be remarkably effective across various agricultural sectors, including
vegetables, fruits, and ornamental plants. As farmers recognized the significant benefits of
precision irrigation, such as reduced water usage and enhanced crop quality, the demand for
innovations in this technology surged. Agri Pipes has emerged as a notable player in this rapidly
evolving field, contributing significantly to the advancements in drip irrigation systems. The
company’s commitment to quality manufacturing has ensured the production of reliable and durable
pipes tailored to meet the diverse needs of farmers. Through a combination of modern engineering,
extensive research, and consideration of local agricultural practices, Agri Pipes has developed
effective solutions that not only address irrigation challenges but also promote sustainability in
farming practices. Over the years, innovations such as pressure-compensating emitters, self-cleaning
filters, and advanced control systems have been pivotal in enhancing the efficiency of drip
irrigation. These advancements reflect the ongoing commitment of companies like Agri Pipes to
support farmers in optimizing water usage and improving crop yields. As the agricultural landscape
continues to evolve, the contributions of drip irrigation technology remain paramount to achieving
sustainable agricultural practices in regions like Tirupattur. Why Choose Agri Pipes for Your
Irrigation Needs? When it comes to selecting a reliable solution for your irrigation needs, Agri
Pipes stands out due to its commitment to quality and innovation. The company utilizes high-quality
materials in the production of their pipes, ensuring durability and longevity, which are essential
for agricultural applications. This focus on material excellence not only minimizes the risk of
damage but also contributes to efficient water management in fields. Agri Pipes offers a
comprehensive range of products, tailored to meet diverse agricultural requirements. From standard
drip irrigation systems to high-tech solutions equipped with advanced technology, farmers can select
from a variety of options that align with their specific needs. This versatility in product
offerings makes Agri Pipes a go-to brand for farmers seeking efficient and effective irrigation
solutions. One of the standout features of Agri Pipes is their customization options. Understanding
that agriculture is not a one-size-fits-all scenario, the company provides tailored solutions that
consider the unique aspects of different crops and soil types. This personalized approach enables
farmers to implement irrigation systems that maximize water efficiency and ensure optimal crop
growth. Customer satisfaction is paramount at Agri Pipes, and numerous testimonials serve as
evidence of the effectiveness of their systems. Farmers have reported significant improvements in
crop yields resulting from the efficient water distribution offered by Agri Pipes’ drip irrigation
services. Case studies further illustrate the positive impact of these systems on water
conservation, demonstrating lower water usage while maintaining, if not enhancing, agricultural
productivity. With these features and benefits prominently positioned, it becomes clear why
partnering with Agri Pipes for your irrigation needs is an investment in the future of your
agriculture business, emphasizing both efficiency and sustainability.

# Landscape Irrigation Serving Anne Arundel County

Arundel Irrigation has served Maryland’s Anne Arundel County for more than 25 years as lawn and
landscape watering specialists. We offer a variety of professional, cost-effective services, such
as:
* **[Lawn irrigation systems][41]**
* **[Home irrigation systems][42]**
* **[In-ground sprinkler systems][43]**
* **[Landscape drainage systems][44]**
* **[Landscape lighting][45]**
* **Driveway drainage systems**
* **[Other Services][46]**

From providing irrigation services to helping create the perfect lighting for your landscape, we
know how to bring out the best in your lawn. When you work with us, you can expect us to provide a
custom-designed, durable, and lasting system that fulfills your needs.

## Irrigation specialists you can trust

After serving Anne Arundel County and the rest of Maryland for a quarter of a century, our services
at Arundel Irrigation have become synonymous with quality, professionalism, and customer service. As
a locally-owned and operated business, we treat our clients as we would our friends, helping them
find affordable, quality products that fit their needs and budget. You can always rely on our team
of certified lawn technicians to provide you with an accurate and insightful estimate.

## Landscape irrigation services for any client

Our team services [residentia][47]l and commercial clients with a range of needs and property sizes.

Our residential clients have included:
* New homes
* Existing homes
* Subdivisions
* Home Owners Associations
* Retirement communities

## Installations, repairs, and inspections of your irrigation system

Whatever you need, Arundel Irrigation can provide it. We offer the installation of high-efficiency
irrigation systems for your residence or commercial property and drainage systems to keep your
foundations dry and free of mold and rot.

We also handle repairs and replacements for broken or damaged pipes and fittings, malfunctioning
sprinkler heads and timers, and storm and lightning damage.

Lastly, we can inspect and diagnose low water pressure issues, such as:
* Leaks and their causes
* Cut, chewed, and broken wires
* Irrigation system coverage and operation
* Seasonal readiness for both winter and spring

If you would like to learn more about the different services we offer, and how we can help you,
please don’t hesitate to contact us today.

## Request an estimate on your service

We proudly offer an estimate package, which includes:
* Complete specs for your current or proposed irrigation system
* Total estimated cost of your project
* Information on possible upgrades to your project
* Warranty information for your proposed service
* References of similar projects we’ve done in the past

Fill out our online request or give us a call for an estimate. When you do, we’ll schedule an
appointment to have our lawn irrigation technician come out and assess your needs. Stop wasting
time, money, and resources by watering your lawn by hand.

**[Call us today for an estimate.][48]**
Contact Us Today

# Landscape Irrigation Serving Anne Arundel County

Arundel Irrigation has served Maryland’s Anne Arundel County for more than 25 years as lawn and
landscape watering specialists. We offer a variety of professional, cost-effective services, such
as:
* **[Lawn irrigation systems][41]**
* **[Home irrigation systems][42]**
* **[In-ground sprinkler systems][43]**
* **[Landscape drainage systems][44]**
* **[Landscape lighting][45]**
* **Driveway drainage systems**
* **[Other Services][46]**

From providing irrigation services to helping create the perfect lighting for your landscape, we
know how to bring out the best in your lawn. When you work with us, you can expect us to provide a
custom-designed, durable, and lasting system that fulfills your needs.

## Irrigation specialists you can trust

After serving Anne Arundel County and the rest of Maryland for a quarter of a century, our services
at Arundel Irrigation have become synonymous with quality, professionalism, and customer service. As
a locally-owned and operated business, we treat our clients as we would our friends, helping them
find affordable, quality products that fit their needs and budget. You can always rely on our team
of certified lawn technicians to provide you with an accurate and insightful estimate.

## Landscape irrigation services for any client

Our team services [residentia][47]l and commercial clients with a range of needs and property sizes.

Our residential clients have included:
* New homes
* Existing homes
* Subdivisions
* Home Owners Associations
* Retirement communities

## Installations, repairs, and inspections of your irrigation system

Whatever you need, Arundel Irrigation can provide it. We offer the installation of high-efficiency
irrigation systems for your residence or commercial property and drainage systems to keep your
foundations dry and free of mold and rot.

We also handle repairs and replacements for broken or damaged pipes and fittings, malfunctioning
sprinkler heads and timers, and storm and lightning damage.

Lastly, we can inspect and diagnose low water pressure issues, such as:
* Leaks and their causes
* Cut, chewed, and broken wires
* Irrigation system coverage and operation
* Seasonal readiness for both winter and spring

If you would like to learn more about the different services we offer, and how we can help you,
please don’t hesitate to contact us today.

## Request an estimate on your service

We proudly offer an estimate package, which includes:
* Complete specs for your current or proposed irrigation system
* Total estimated cost of your project
* Information on possible upgrades to your project
* Warranty information for your proposed service
* References of similar projects we’ve done in the past

Fill out our online request or give us a call for an estimate. When you do, we’ll schedule an
appointment to have our lawn irrigation technician come out and assess your needs. Stop wasting
time, money, and resources by watering your lawn by hand.

**[Call us today for an estimate.][48]**
Contact Us Today

Hear Our Happy Customers

In saline-alkali land environments, the drip irrigation belt has excellent corrosion resistance and

terms of price, under the premise of ensuring product quality, we are given a lot of preferential
space, which reduces the operating costs of the cooperative. What touched us most is that the
service team will visit us regularly to help us check the operation of the irrigation system and
provide professional technical guidance for the irrigation problems we encounter. Such a caring and
professional partner is trustworthy!

As a large farmer in South America, we have been cooperating with Baoding Runnong Irrigation Co.,
Ltd. for agricultural irrigation products for more than two years. The quality of the drip tape,
micro-spray tape and main pipe they provide is really amazing! Made of high-quality anti-aging
materials, they can maintain good toughness and sealing even under the scorching sun and complex
soil environment, greatly reducing the maintenance frequency of the irrigation system. What is more
reassuring is that no matter how big or small the order is, the delivery time is as stable as a
clock. For the urgent order before the planting season last year, they completed the delivery in

# Irrigation System Company in Seminole, TX

B&M Pump Irrigation Sales & Service, Inc. is your complete irrigation specialist, serving the
greater Southwest region of the U.S. Call on us for well and pump service, irrigation system design,
pivot systems and much more. We strive to educate owners and operators on making pumps and motors
last longer and work more efficiently. Contact us today to learn more about our many
*[**services**][160]* and center pivot irrigation designs in Seminole and Gaines County, TX, along
with the rest of the state of Texas.

## High-Quality, Customized Irrigation Solutions

If you’re looking for an irrigation solutions provider who can do it all, look no further than B&M
Pump Irrigation Sales & Service, Inc. We’re a leader among irrigation companies in the Southwest
U.S., with abilities spanning all types of irrigation and potable water systems. We even tackle more
advanced designs, like WiFi irrigation systems!

## Water Well Drilling Services

At BMP Pumps & Irrigation, we provide complete water well services, including professional drilling
for new wells tailored to your property’s specific needs. Our expert team handles everything from
start to finish—rebuilding or replacing pumps, air jetting, test pumping, and casing scrubbing—to
ensure reliable, long-lasting water flow. Whether you’re starting fresh or maintaining an existing
system, we deliver dependable, end-to-end well solutions.

wide selection of farm irrigation supplies. We even deal with existing systems and can work on all
brands of pivots. We’ll make sure your irrigation system works as-needed, with an emphasis on safe,
efficient, reliable function.

### Complete Irrigation System Repair & More

Alongside smart irrigation systems, our expertise also extends to well and *[**central pump**][167]*
services. We’re the company to call if you’ve got issues with your submersible or turbine pump. Not

Pump Irrigation Sales & Service, Inc. We’re a leader among irrigation companies in the Southwest

system, we deliver dependable, end-to-end well solutions.

## CAPTAIN - A LEADER IN MICRO IRRIGATION

Captain is a pioneer in manufacturing of advanced micro irrigation technologies in India. Our
irrigation systems which include drip irrigation systems and sprinkler irrigation systems are
produced from advanced German and Israel technology. We have two state of the art manufacturing
facilities (Rajkot and Kurnool) to ensure the best quality products. We have a strong marketing and
distribution network with presence in 16 states of India with more than 750 dealers. Our focus on
good quality irrigation systems and agronomical services made **"CAPTAIN"** a reputed brand in
domestic and international market.

Minimal Maintenance
We build our products keeping in mind lowest maintenance and optimal performance depending on our
customer's requirements.
Powerful Design
Our products comes with latest state-of-the-art design with compact structure, best efficiency and
easily manageable during the life.
Best Quality Product
We believe in supplying best quality products. Our all products undergo stringent quality checks to
ensure best quality product.
Excellent Support
Providing excellent agronomy and after sales service to make sure our customer is happy and
satisfied with our products.


## CAPTAIN’S COMMITMENT TOWARDS THE ENVIRONMENT

Providing sustainable long term solutions towards the environment is not only a business at Captain
but a commitment towards the environment. Farmers around the world are under immense pressure due to
depleting ground water sources. Captain Polyplast’s Micro irrigation solutions helps farmers tackle
these challenges by optimizing their water utilisation efficiently by around 60% and also delivering
higher agricultural yields by controlling the soil moisture levels which aid in crop growth and also
improve yields.

#### In the financial year 2020, we covered ~40,000 hectares of land under micro irrigation, saving
#### around 20 Billion Litres of water or an equivalent amount of water to fill 8,000 Olympic size
#### swimming pools.

Ultimate Solution for Micro Irrigation
We offer superior quality drip irrigation system. Our drip irrigation system includes ISI Marked
Mainline, Submainline, Integral Drip Lines Lateral, Dripper and is supported by wide range of
fittings to suit various conditions resulting in long life of our product.
Our drip irrigation system is operated through ISI marked Screen/Disc filters.
[View More][65]

Injector, Sprinkler Irrigation System, Sprinkler Fittings, Mini Sprinkler Irrigation System, Green
House, Solar System, Fertilizer and Polymer

## CAPTAIN - A LEADER IN MICRO IRRIGATION

Captain is a pioneer in manufacturing of advanced micro irrigation technologies in India. Our
irrigation systems which include drip irrigation systems and sprinkler irrigation systems are
produced from advanced German and Israel technology. We have two state of the art manufacturing
facilities (Rajkot and Kurnool) to ensure the best quality products. We have a strong marketing and
distribution network with presence in 16 states of India with more than 750 dealers. Our focus on
good quality irrigation systems and agronomical services made **"CAPTAIN"** a reputed brand in
domestic and international market.

Minimal Maintenance
We build our products keeping in mind lowest maintenance and optimal performance depending on our
customer's requirements.
Powerful Design
Our products comes with latest state-of-the-art design with compact structure, best efficiency and
easily manageable during the life.
Best Quality Product
We believe in supplying best quality products. Our all products undergo stringent quality checks to
ensure best quality product.
Excellent Support
Providing excellent agronomy and after sales service to make sure our customer is happy and
satisfied with our products.


## CAPTAIN’S COMMITMENT TOWARDS THE ENVIRONMENT

Providing sustainable long term solutions towards the environment is not only a business at Captain
but a commitment towards the environment. Farmers around the world are under immense pressure due to
depleting ground water sources. Captain Polyplast’s Micro irrigation solutions helps farmers tackle
these challenges by optimizing their water utilisation efficiently by around 60% and also delivering
higher agricultural yields by controlling the soil moisture levels which aid in crop growth and also
improve yields.

#### In the financial year 2020, we covered ~40,000 hectares of land under micro irrigation, saving
#### around 20 Billion Litres of water or an equivalent amount of water to fill 8,000 Olympic size
#### swimming pools.

Ultimate Solution for Micro Irrigation
We offer superior quality drip irrigation system. Our drip irrigation system includes ISI Marked
Mainline, Submainline, Integral Drip Lines Lateral, Dripper and is supported by wide range of
fittings to suit various conditions resulting in long life of our product.
Our drip irrigation system is operated through ISI marked Screen/Disc filters.

# A Cut Above

Heritage Artificial Turf covers residential, commercial, sports, and pet applications. It's durable,
low-maintenance, and designed for the Midwest climate, making it the smart choice for every
landscape professional.

[Discover H.A.T. Products][33]
[ICON]

# Residential

This top-notch turf is ideal for residential lawns. Rest assured, your project will showcase
premium, PFAS-Free turf that flawlessly emulates natural grass.

[ICON]

# Commercial

Our long-lasting products endure the test of time, retaining their pristine appearance well beyond
installation. Safety is our top priority, reflected in our thorough third-party testing to ensure
our turf is free from PFAS.

[ICON]

# Golf

Transform your customer's outdoor space into a golfing oasis with superior attention to detail. Our
PFAS Free products are crafted to match every golfer’s needs. Whether you are looking for a
conversation piece or a tour-grade quality putting green, you can bring their golf game home!

[ICON]

# Sports

With our extensive range of products, we have everything you need for your next sports application,
whether indoor or outdoor. Our range of turf boasts superior durability, capable of withstanding
whatever you throw, hit, or slide on them. Keep your customers and athletes safe with our PFAS-Free
turf.

[ICON]

# Pets

Our artificial turf is specifically designed with pets in mind. Our products are engineered to
resist absorption, drain quickly with an industry-leading drainage rate of 505 gallons per hour per
square yard, and boast extra durability, all while being PFAS-free.

[ICON]

# Playground

Ensure your turf installation is safe for all with our PFAS-Free turf. Featuring unrivaled natural
colors, your project will stand out above the rest. Our fibers are designed to withstand
high-traffic family or playground play, ensuring your project maintains its pristine appearance from
installation onward.

outdoor spaces. Whether it’s ornamental maintenance or extensive vegetation management, Heritage has

# [Sourdough Symphony][43]

Join us in the craft of sourdough baking, exploring the rich history, science, and art behind this
ancient bread. Together, we'll create crusty, soulful masterpieces right from your home oven.

## Texas-Proud and Meaning It

#### [Taco Loco][44]

Aside from BBQ, another food item that is typically associated with Texas is the lovely Taco! Get
the best information on this Texan (and American) favorite from tips and tricks to making the best
tacos, taco origins, and even in-depth information on the different specialty taco types!

#### [Butter Lasso][45]

Wrangle up your taste buds and get ready for a wild ride! Our blog is dedicated to exploring the
delicious world of cowboy butter. From savory recipes to creative pairing ideas, we'll show you how
to elevate your dishes with this flavorful spread. Grab your apron and let's get cooking!

#### [Lone Star Germania][46]

Willkommen! Discover the rich tapestry of German culture woven into the heart of Texas. From the
first waves of immigration to the enduring traditions, language, and cuisine, we explore the
fascinating stories and vibrant communities that have shaped the German experience in the Lone Star
State. Join us on this journey!

Immerse yourself in the rugged charm of the Lone Star State as we explore the rich traditions of
Texas cowboys. From the clink of spurs to the lore of the range, join us on a journey through the
history, lifestyle, and enduring spirit of the western frontier.

#### [Searing Tongues][48]

Dive into the fiery world of hot sauces, where bold flavors and daring heat levels reign supreme.
From the rich history of spicy condiments to the latest tongue-tingling creations, we'll explore the
diverse landscape of hot sauces, sharing expert tips, brand spotlights, and unforgettable culinary
adventures along the way.

#### [Mixology, TX][49]

Discover the vibrant, diverse world of Texas cocktails, from classic concoctions to innovative
creations. Join us as we explore the Lone Star State's thriving bar scene, meet the talented
mixologists behind the drinks, and uncover the stories and secrets that make Texas a true cocktail
destination. Cheers, y'all!

Embark on a local food journey across America with our comprehensive guides. Discover the rich
tapestry of Community Supported Agriculture offerings in each state, connecting you with fresh,
sustainable, and seasonal produce directly from the hands of the farmers who grow it. Join the
movement nurturing community and agriculture.

### [Peak Produce][51]

When it comes to enjoying the freshest flavors and optimal nutrition, timing matters. The “Peak
Produce” section is your guide to recognizing when fruits and vegetables are at their prime.

#### [State Soil Stories][52]

loam of Iowa to the volcanic soils of Hawaii, we explore the unique state soils that shape farming
communities. Discover the stories of resilient farmers, innovative practices, and the deep
connection between people and the land they cultivate.

### [Metro Bounty][53]

Welcome to a fresh take on local farming in the cityscape! Dive into our city-specific guides and
uncover the vibrant world of community-supported agriculture. Discover local CSA programs, city
initiatives, and resources to connect with farm-fresh goodness right in your urban backyard. Join us
on this green journey.

## How to Eat

#### [Fast Forward][55]

Intermittent fasting alternates between periods of eating and fasting to potentially improve health
and promote weight loss.

#### [Keto Clarity Hub][56]

The ketogenic diet is a high-fat, low-carbohydrate eating plan designed to induce ketosis, a
metabolic state in which the body burns fat for fuel instead of carbohydrates.

#### [The Paleo Diet][57]

The paleo diet emphasizes eating like early humans, focusing on whole foods and excluding grains,
dairy, and processed items.

#### [The High Fat Diet][58]

The high-fat diet is rich in fats and often low in carbohydrates, aiming to promote ketosis or
improve body composition.

#### [Beyond Grains][59]

A no-grains diet eliminates all grain products, including wheat, rice, and corn, focusing on other
whole foods.

#### [The Diet Decoder][60]

Your no-nonsense guide to understanding today's popular diets. Here, we cut through the hype to
explore the science and real-world results behind each eating plan.

#### [Flex Feast & Flora][61]

Embark on a journey where nutritious plants meet occasional meat indulgence. The flexitarian diet
offers a balanced, eco-friendly approach to eating—less meat, more plants, without strict rules.
Discover delicious versatility and health benefits in every bite, tailored for the modern, conscious
eater. Welcome to a world of flexible dining.

#### [Lactose Intolerance 101][62]

Discover everything you need to know about living with lactose intolerance. From understanding the
causes and symptoms to finding the best lactose-free alternatives, our blog is here to guide you
through your journey. Join us as we explore the world of lactose intolerance and learn to thrive
without dairy.

#### [The Pure Pegan Path][63]

Embark on a culinary journey where paleo meets vegan. The Pegan Diet harmonizes whole, nutrient-rich
foods for optimal health. Dive into recipes, tips, and the science behind this lifestyle, ensuring a
delicious balance that nurtures both body and planet. Join us as we explore the art of Pegan living.

#### [Vegan or Not?][64]

Navigating the world of vegan food can be challenging. Our blog is dedicated to answering your
burning questions about the vegan status of various foods, from everyday snacks ([What wine goes
well with snacks?][65]) to gourmet dishes. With informative articles and helpful insights, we'll
help you make informed choices on your vegan journey.

## Keep on Truckin’

#### [Food Truck Laws Across America][66]

Embark on a culinary adventure with confidence as you explore the diverse tapestry of food truck
laws across America. Our guide provides a detailed overview of the regulations that govern mobile
eateries, offering insights and tips to ensure your food truck business thrives within the legal
landscape. From health codes to parking restrictions, stay ahead of the curve and turn your food
truck dreams into reality.

#### [Starting a Food Truck][67]

Dive into the exciting world of mobile cuisine with our essential guide to starting a food truck
business. We'll walk you through the maze of food truck laws, permits, and regulations that vary
across the US, while providing you with a clear roadmap to bring your culinary concept to the
streets. Whether you're crafting gourmet bites or classic comfort food, our guide is the perfect
recipe for turning your food truck into a bustling hub of deliciousness.

## Agritourism

#### [Saddle Up][68]

Embark on a journey through the heart of America with our state-by-state guide to the country's most
enchanting dude and guest ranches. Discover the unique charm, adventure, and hospitality each locale
offers, from horseback riding under vast skies to cozy evenings by the campfire. Saddle up for the
ride!

#### [United States of Agritourism][69]

Embark on a journey through America's heartland with "United States of Agritourism: A State-by-State
Guide." Discover the charm of rural life, explore local farms, and savor homegrown delights. From
coast to coast, we'll guide you through the best agritourism experiences each state has to offer.
Get ready to explore!

#### [Pasture to Present][70]

Embark on a rustic journey with "Pasture to Present," your ultimate guide to exploring the rich
heritage of America's historical farms and farm museums. Discover each state's unique agricultural
past, and see history come alive, from colonial homesteads to the heartland's prairies. Join us in
celebrating America's agrarian roots.

## Growing Your Own Food

#### [Grow Your Own Food][71]

Growing your own food is an effective way to reduce your foodprint while keeping yourself busy with
a relaxing and enjoyable task. By taking charge of the entire process from planting to composting,
you can select the seed, manage soil & pest, and harvest everything on your own. Whether it's a
windowsill of herbs or a backyard vegetable plot, you can tailor a garden to suit your lifestyle
needs. We provide various garden guides, including seed selection information and a step-by-step
gardening guide, as well as ways to make the most of your fresh produce. Get ready to start
gardening and enhance your eco-friendliness!

#### [The Compost Conundrum][72]

Welcome to "The Compost Conundrum," your ultimate guide to mastering the art of composting. Discover
what's compostable, what's not, and how to transform your kitchen scraps into garden gold. From egg
cartons to apple cores, we'll tackle all your compost queries with practical, easy-to-follow advice.
Let's dig in!

#### [The State-by-State Guide to Vegetable Gardening][73]

Welcome to The State-by-State Guide to Vegetable Gardening! In this section you'll find customized
vegetable gardening advice and information for every US state. Each page provides growing calendars,
recommended plant varieties, and other location-specific tips to help you plan and grow the best
home garden possible based on your area's climate and conditions. Start exploring your state's page
today to unlock your garden's full potential!

#### [Urban Compost Chronicles][74]

Welcome to "Urban Compost Chronicles," the ultimate resource for city composting. Navigate local
regulations, discover services, and master eco-friendly waste practices. Whether you're a seasoned
composter or a green-living novice, our city-specific guides empower you to enrich soil and
sustainability in your urban oasis. Join the green revolution!

## Your Life, Your Health

#### [Nature's Wellness Almanac][75]

Embark on a path to optimal health with our treasure trove of natural remedies and wellness wisdom.
From herbal solutions to nutritional insights, our blog empowers you to lead a life enriched by

## How to Eat

#### [Fast Forward][55]

Intermittent fasting alternates between periods of eating and fasting to potentially improve health
and promote weight loss.

#### [Keto Clarity Hub][56]

The ketogenic diet is a high-fat, low-carbohydrate eating plan designed to induce ketosis, a
metabolic state in which the body burns fat for fuel instead of carbohydrates.

#### [The Paleo Diet][57]

The paleo diet emphasizes eating like early humans, focusing on whole foods and excluding grains,
dairy, and processed items.

#### [The High Fat Diet][58]

The high-fat diet is rich in fats and often low in carbohydrates, aiming to promote ketosis or
improve body composition.

#### [Beyond Grains][59]

A no-grains diet eliminates all grain products, including wheat, rice, and corn, focusing on other
whole foods.

#### [The Diet Decoder][60]

Your no-nonsense guide to understanding today's popular diets. Here, we cut through the hype to
explore the science and real-world results behind each eating plan.

#### [Flex Feast & Flora][61]

Embark on a journey where nutritious plants meet occasional meat indulgence. The flexitarian diet
offers a balanced, eco-friendly approach to eating—less meat, more plants, without strict rules.
Discover delicious versatility and health benefits in every bite, tailored for the modern, conscious
eater. Welcome to a world of flexible dining.

#### [Lactose Intolerance 101][62]

Discover everything you need to know about living with lactose intolerance. From understanding the
causes and symptoms to finding the best lactose-free alternatives, our blog is here to guide you
through your journey. Join us as we explore the world of lactose intolerance and learn to thrive
without dairy.

#### [The Pure Pegan Path][63]

Embark on a culinary journey where paleo meets vegan. The Pegan Diet harmonizes whole, nutrient-rich
foods for optimal health. Dive into recipes, tips, and the science behind this lifestyle, ensuring a
delicious balance that nurtures both body and planet. Join us as we explore the art of Pegan living.

#### [Vegan or Not?][64]

Navigating the world of vegan food can be challenging. Our blog is dedicated to answering your
burning questions about the vegan status of various foods, from everyday snacks ([What wine goes
well with snacks?][65]) to gourmet dishes. With informative articles and helpful insights, we'll
help you make informed choices on your vegan journey.

## Keep on Truckin’

#### [Food Truck Laws Across America][66]

Embark on a culinary adventure with confidence as you explore the diverse tapestry of food truck
laws across America. Our guide provides a detailed overview of the regulations that govern mobile
eateries, offering insights and tips to ensure your food truck business thrives within the legal
landscape. From health codes to parking restrictions, stay ahead of the curve and turn your food
truck dreams into reality.

#### [Starting a Food Truck][67]

Dive into the exciting world of mobile cuisine with our essential guide to starting a food truck
business. We'll walk you through the maze of food truck laws, permits, and regulations that vary
across the US, while providing you with a clear roadmap to bring your culinary concept to the
streets. Whether you're crafting gourmet bites or classic comfort food, our guide is the perfect
recipe for turning your food truck into a bustling hub of deliciousness.

## Agritourism

#### [Saddle Up][68]

Embark on a journey through the heart of America with our state-by-state guide to the country's most
enchanting dude and guest ranches. Discover the unique charm, adventure, and hospitality each locale
offers, from horseback riding under vast skies to cozy evenings by the campfire. Saddle up for the
ride!

#### [United States of Agritourism][69]

Embark on a journey through America's heartland with "United States of Agritourism: A State-by-State
Guide." Discover the charm of rural life, explore local farms, and savor homegrown delights. From
coast to coast, we'll guide you through the best agritourism experiences each state has to offer.
Get ready to explore!

#### [Pasture to Present][70]

Embark on a rustic journey with "Pasture to Present," your ultimate guide to exploring the rich
heritage of America's historical farms and farm museums. Discover each state's unique agricultural
past, and see history come alive, from colonial homesteads to the heartland's prairies. Join us in
celebrating America's agrarian roots.

## Growing Your Own Food

#### [Grow Your Own Food][71]

Growing your own food is an effective way to reduce your foodprint while keeping yourself busy with
a relaxing and enjoyable task. By taking charge of the entire process from planting to composting,
you can select the seed, manage soil & pest, and harvest everything on your own. Whether it's a
windowsill of herbs or a backyard vegetable plot, you can tailor a garden to suit your lifestyle
needs. We provide various garden guides, including seed selection information and a step-by-step
gardening guide, as well as ways to make the most of your fresh produce. Get ready to start
gardening and enhance your eco-friendliness!

#### [The Compost Conundrum][72]

Welcome to "The Compost Conundrum," your ultimate guide to mastering the art of composting. Discover
what's compostable, what's not, and how to transform your kitchen scraps into garden gold. From egg
cartons to apple cores, we'll tackle all your compost queries with practical, easy-to-follow advice.
Let's dig in!

#### [The State-by-State Guide to Vegetable Gardening][73]

Welcome to The State-by-State Guide to Vegetable Gardening! In this section you'll find customized
vegetable gardening advice and information for every US state. Each page provides growing calendars,
recommended plant varieties, and other location-specific tips to help you plan and grow the best
home garden possible based on your area's climate and conditions. Start exploring your state's page
today to unlock your garden's full potential!

#### [Urban Compost Chronicles][74]

Welcome to "Urban Compost Chronicles," the ultimate resource for city composting. Navigate local
regulations, discover services, and master eco-friendly waste practices. Whether you're a seasoned
composter or a green-living novice, our city-specific guides empower you to enrich soil and
sustainability in your urban oasis. Join the green revolution!

### High-Quality Drip Irrigation Systems Designed for Indian Agriculture

An extremely effective and water-efficient irrigation technique, **drip irrigation Manufacturer**
are made to precisely and carefully supply water to plant roots. In order to guarantee that crops
receive precisely the quantity of water they require, this system uses a network of pipelines,
emitters, and valves to release water in tiny, constant drops. **[ Drip Irrigation ][15]** is the
best option for regions with water scarcity or erratic rainfall patterns because it minimizes water
waste by lowering transpiration and runoff.

### Below mentioned are the few components of Drip Irrigation

### Water Source

The primary **sources of water **, such as a well, pond, or municipal supply, that feeds the
irrigation system.

### Emitters (Drippers)

Devices that release water slowly and directly to the plant roots in small, controlled amounts.

### Distribution System

The distribution of water that may be above the ground or underground, and the pipes used for
distribution are most commonly made of PVC or Polyethylene plastics. Further aluminum pipes are also
accessible but it is very difficult to customize, cut or repair.

### Drip Tubing/Pipes

Flexible pipes that carry water from the mainline to the plants. They are equipped with emitters
along their length.

### Injectors

Used to allow the introduction of fertilizer, chemical and maintenance products into the Irrigation
System and the most common injectors used with small Drip-irrigation System are the venturi
injector.

### Backflow Preventer

Prevents contaminated water from flowing back into the main water supply, ensuring clean water usage
in drip irrigation valve.

### Filtration System

The filtration system removes large solid particles in suspension in the water. The essential part
of Drip Irrigation Manufacturer is Filtration, A drip irrigation Supplier should never be worked
without a filter System even if the filter requires clogged drip-tape emitters, often ensuing in
poor uniformity and sometimes in crop loss.

injector.

in drip irrigation valve.

Who We Are

## A new paradigm in drip irrigation.

**Driptech** was born in the USA in 2008 — a breakthrough innovation of* 'Laser-Punched Drip'*
technology developed at Stanford University, making drip irrigation highly economical, energy
efficient and almost maintenance-free.

A wholly-owned subsidiary of **Jain Irrigation Systems** — a global leader in drip irrigation —
Driptech India delivers a complete range of cost-effective solutions for every kind of farm. [Check

What Does It Offer?

### Economical. Efficient. Reliable. Low Maintenance.

[Technology quadrant — Economical, Energy Efficient, Reliable, Low Maintenance]
How Is It Achieved?

### Three interlocking pillars driving the revolution.

[Three gears — Laser-Punched Drip Technology, Value Engineering, Product Innovation]
Core Innovation

### 'Laser-Punched Drip' Technology.

The clogging-prone dripper insert used in traditional dripline is completely eliminated. In its
place, a very precise dripper hole is made using a precision laser machine — delivering consistent,
reliable flow with rare chance of clogging.

The Breakthrough

Precision laser ablation creates a hole of exact diameter and geometry directly in the pipe wall —
replacing the entire dripper assembly with a single, clog-proof aperture.

[Laser-Punched Drip technology close-up]
Dripper-less drip — a technological marvel
Value Engineering

### Balancing functionality & cost.

Every design decision is made with farmers' precise requirements in mind — delivering world-class
irrigation performance at a price point accessible to small farm holders in developing countries.

AffordableDurableLow PressureEasy RepairLocally Sourced
Product Innovation
* DT-Flexi Pipe — flexible substitute for rigid PVC/HDPE pipes
* Laser Spray Mini Champ — compact rain pipe
* Ultra Low Pressure Sprinkler — works from 1 kg/cm²
* SprinklEasy — simple plug-and-play sprinkler solution

### Many more to come.

Our Mission

## Drip irrigation is an amazing technology.

It saves water, fertilizer, energy and labour — and dramatically improves the yield and quality of
produce. Yet it remains under-adopted in the developing world.

Adoption barriers we remove:
* High Initial Investment
* High Running Cost
* Maintenance Issues

"Our mission is to deliver new revolutionary drip irrigation technology across the globe — helping
every farmer, including small farm holders, adopt drip irrigation."

Saves Water
Up to 70% less than flood irrigation.
Saves Fertilizer
Precise delivery, zero runoff.
Saves Energy
Works at ultra-low pressure.
Saves Labour
Set it once, let it run.
Boosts Yield
Dramatically improved produce quality.

Almost maintenance-free design.

Who We Are

## A new paradigm in drip irrigation.

**Driptech** was born in the USA in 2008 — a breakthrough innovation of* 'Laser-Punched Drip'*
technology developed at Stanford University, making drip irrigation highly economical, energy
efficient and almost maintenance-free.

A wholly-owned subsidiary of **Jain Irrigation Systems** — a global leader in drip irrigation —
Driptech India delivers a complete range of cost-effective solutions for every kind of farm. [Check
Our Story][12]

What Does It Offer?

### Economical. Efficient. Reliable. Low Maintenance.

[Technology quadrant — Economical, Energy Efficient, Reliable, Low Maintenance]
How Is It Achieved?

### Three interlocking pillars driving the revolution.

[Three gears — Laser-Punched Drip Technology, Value Engineering, Product Innovation]
Core Innovation

### 'Laser-Punched Drip' Technology.

The clogging-prone dripper insert used in traditional dripline is completely eliminated. In its
place, a very precise dripper hole is made using a precision laser machine — delivering consistent,
reliable flow with rare chance of clogging.

The Breakthrough

Precision laser ablation creates a hole of exact diameter and geometry directly in the pipe wall —
replacing the entire dripper assembly with a single, clog-proof aperture.

[Laser-Punched Drip technology close-up]
Dripper-less drip — a technological marvel
Value Engineering

### Balancing functionality & cost.

Every design decision is made with farmers' precise requirements in mind — delivering world-class
irrigation performance at a price point accessible to small farm holders in developing countries.

AffordableDurableLow PressureEasy RepairLocally Sourced
Product Innovation
* DT-Flexi Pipe — flexible substitute for rigid PVC/HDPE pipes
* Laser Spray Mini Champ — compact rain pipe
* Ultra Low Pressure Sprinkler — works from 1 kg/cm²
* SprinklEasy — simple plug-and-play sprinkler solution

### Many more to come.

Our Mission

## Drip irrigation is an amazing technology.

It saves water, fertilizer, energy and labour — and dramatically improves the yield and quality of
produce. Yet it remains under-adopted in the developing world.

Adoption barriers we remove:
* High Initial Investment
* High Running Cost
* Maintenance Issues

"Our mission is to deliver new revolutionary drip irrigation technology across the globe — helping
every farmer, including small farm holders, adopt drip irrigation."

Saves Water
Up to 70% less than flood irrigation.
Saves Fertilizer
Precise delivery, zero runoff.
Saves Energy
Works at ultra-low pressure.
Saves Labour
Set it once, let it run.
Boosts Yield
Dramatically improved produce quality.
Low Maintenance
Almost maintenance-free design.

### Drip Irrigation Basics

Drip irrigation is the most efficient irrigation method available, delivering water and inputs
directly to the plant's root zone.

### Drip System Design Tools

Our drip irrigation tools can help you calculate payback, design your new drip system and optimize
your irrigation system for maximum yields and minimal costs.

#### Total Irrigation Solution

## About Ecoflo Irrigation

Manufacturing of irrigation systems since 1991.

We market our products under the brand name Bhavani Drip in the Indian market and Ecoflo Irrigation
Systems in the international market. Ours is the only company in the world that produces low cost
irrigation kits and manual pumping along with a complete range of micro irrigation systems. At the
same time, it is one of the very few companies which can boast of designing, supplying and
installing the most cost-effective drip irrigation system for large commercial farms.

EcofloIndia is one of the best drip irrigation system company in India and worldwide . We are one of
the  best manufacturers of irrigation systems and also have the best micro irrigation systems in
India as well as abroad .

Drip/ micro irrigation is the process of giving water directly to the root-zone of the plants.
Today, farmers save substantially on expensive fertilizers by efficient fertigation through drip
irrigation. This has proven with high yields along with better quality. Bhinge Brothers provide
expertise in such a drip system that optimises on use of water and fertilizers effectively. With the
option of low cost thin walled but yet very dependable driplines, farmers need not rely on
government subsidy support and also get encouraged to invest into such systems for larger areas due
to quick return on investment. EcofloIndia is recognised as one of the well known drip irrigation
system consultants and Suppliers in India as well as world wide .

We have acquired huge recognition for being one of the well known irrigation driplines suppliers in
India and also in the international market.  We have been  acknowledged as being one of the best
drip irrigation systems in India .We manufacture best quality Irrigation Drip kits In India and
export them  worldwide.

### Customer Feedback

In 2009, I started using Bhavani drip system and everything worked perfectly. I have found that the
system is very simple and easy to operate once its set up, and that its just like any other piece of

# IRRIGATION. PIPE. SEPTIC.

We’re a wholesale distributor that proudly serves in the supply of irrigation, septic, wastewater,
and mechanical products to the Calgary, Kelowna, and Burnaby markets.

[Let's get to work][11]
[[ADS Logo]][12]

[Irrigation Thumbnail]

## Irrigation

Pop-ups, rotors, controllers, drip irrigation and more. Everything you need to install and repair
commercial and residential irrigation.

**[Irrigation Vendors ][17]**

[Irrigation Thumbnail]

## Pipe

We specialize in all things Schedule 40 & 80, stocking thousands of fittings and ½” to 8” pipe with
access to additional sizes.

**[Pipe Vendors ][18]**

[Irrigation Thumbnail]

## Septic

Partnering with installers city wide we carry all your installation and repair needs. Pumps, floats,
and alarms are always in stock with us.

**[Septic Vendors ][19]**

## About EMCO Irrigation, Pipe, & Septic

[EMCO Irrigation building exterior with parked cars.]

Our team is committed to providing you with world-class service, the EMCO Way. We are dedicated to
earning and continuing to be your first-choice distributor. Our goal is to develop lasting
relationships with our customers and support you in all your project needs. We strive to keep our
inventory stocked to ensure you never leave empty-handed, and to create positive interactions with
every visit. At our locations, we are always learning and adapting to ensure our knowledge is up to
date and that we are changing with the industry.

EMCO Irrigation, Pipe and Septic is pleased to align our business with the best brand names in the
industry. The vendors we partner with offer quality products, reliability and a large selection of
product solutions allowing us to cater to you for all your project needs across Calgary, Burnaby,
and Kelowna.

[Contact Us][20]

## Our Values

Every employee at EMCO is expected to live our core values, which are a crucial point in our hiring
process and in our day-to-day interactions with customers, suppliers, and employees.

[Learn about the EMCO difference][21]

### Fairness and Caring

Doing the right thing and being committed to the success of others. Showing others by our words and
actions that we genuinely care about them personally and professionally

### Trust and Respect

Acting with integrity and leading by example. Always doing what we say we are going to do. Being
trusting and respectful of others.

### Generous Listening

Listening carefully and deeply to ensure we fully understand each other. Being open to new ideas.
Suspending our judgments in a way that encourages others to share their opinions and allows us to
hear what others are truly saying.

### Straight Talk

Respectfully saying the things we really mean in a timely manner and in the spirit of fairness and
support of others. Providing feedback and being committed to having the conversations that are
needed.

[[EMCO Corporation Irrigation, Pipe, and Septic logo]][22]

EMCO Corporation is one of Canada’s largest integrated distributors of products for the construction
industry.

## About EMCO Irrigation, Pipe, & Septic

[EMCO Irrigation building exterior with parked cars.]

Our team is committed to providing you with world-class service, the EMCO Way. We are dedicated to
earning and continuing to be your first-choice distributor. Our goal is to develop lasting
relationships with our customers and support you in all your project needs. We strive to keep our
inventory stocked to ensure you never leave empty-handed, and to create positive interactions with
every visit. At our locations, we are always learning and adapting to ensure our knowledge is up to
date and that we are changing with the industry.

EMCO Irrigation, Pipe and Septic is pleased to align our business with the best brand names in the
industry. The vendors we partner with offer quality products, reliability and a large selection of
product solutions allowing us to cater to you for all your project needs across Calgary, Burnaby,
and Kelowna.

[Contact Us][20]

## Our Values

Every employee at EMCO is expected to live our core values, which are a crucial point in our hiring
process and in our day-to-day interactions with customers, suppliers, and employees.

[Learn about the EMCO difference][21]

### Fairness and Caring

Doing the right thing and being committed to the success of others. Showing others by our words and
actions that we genuinely care about them personally and professionally

### Trust and Respect

Acting with integrity and leading by example. Always doing what we say we are going to do. Being
trusting and respectful of others.

### Generous Listening

Listening carefully and deeply to ensure we fully understand each other. Being open to new ideas.
Suspending our judgments in a way that encourages others to share their opinions and allows us to
hear what others are truly saying.

### Straight Talk

Respectfully saying the things we really mean in a timely manner and in the spirit of fairness and
support of others. Providing feedback and being committed to having the conversations that are
needed.

EMPIRE DRIP SUPPLY offers a comprehensive line of drip irrigation products for vegetables, fruit and
berry growers, nurseries and greenhouses, vineyards, hemp and hops growers. We are conveniently
located in western NY just off of Route 104.

We sell products from these fine vendors:

 


#### About Us

Empire Drip Supply- a new name in the New York Ag industry. Our business may be young but our team
brings two generations of experience in agriculture including several years of supplying drip
irrigation products. We offer quality names in irrigation and agriculture supplies. Our industry
specific knowledge helps us customize a comprehensive product line with a variety of tools to help
support your agricultural business. We ship daily from our warehouse located at 5951 S Geneva Rd.
Sodus, NY 14551.

#### Need help designing an irrigation system?

We are happy to help! Give us basic information on our handy design form, and we can give you a
quote of the overall design. If you choose to purchase the system, you will get a full map design,
an itemized and detailed parts list, and free support from our designer!

#### Pick Up, Shipping & Delivery
* Customers are encouraged to come pick up their orders from our facility.
* Customer is responsible for all shipping costs. We use USPS & UPS daily for small items, and LTL
  carriers for pallet quantities.
* As a customer service, we are working to arrange pooled delivery service into various areas of NYS
  and surrounding.
* Please help us get your product quickly and cost effectively by placing your order at least a week
  in advance of when you need it, that way you have the greatest opportunity to save on shipping!

#### Terms and Conditions

We accept all major credit cards; cash, check or money order. Claims for shortage or damaged items
MUST be made within 7 days of receipt of shipment. All prices subject to change without notice.
Credit card payments for amounts over $3,000 are subject to a 2% credit card fee.

#### Returns

All returns for credit must include invoice and may have a 10% restocking charge.

#### Special Orders

Custom order items are non-refundable and must be paid in advance

## Seeds

Looking to get your seeds started indoors or direct sown the right way? Find out all you need to
know about starting seeds in these comprehensive guides!

[View all][143]
[ [A plant with seeds still attached to the top of the stem with dried buds surrounding it ready for
beginner seed-saving] ][144]

[Seeds][145]

### [ A Beginner’s Guide to Seed-Saving in the Garden ][146]

[ [Three white plastic trays sit on a windowsill, filled with dark, moist soil. Sprouts of various
heights and thickness carpet the soil, their leaves a vibrant shade of green. A few delicate stems
stretch towards the window, bathed in the soft glow of the morning sun.] ][147]

[Seeds][148]

### [ 21 Easy to Start Seeds for Beginner Gardeners ][149]

[ [Scarify seeds. Close-up of a man's hand scarifying bean seeds with sandpaper on a white table.
Sandpaper is a rough-textured material commonly used for smoothing or shaping surfaces through
abrasion. The surface of sandpaper feels coarse and gritty to the touch and has a brownish-burgundy
tint. Bean seeds are oval, with a smooth surface and a firm texture. They are cream-colored with a
glossy surface. The man rubs the seed on sandpaper, leaving a strip of small powder-like remains of
the seed shell.] ][150]

[Seeds][151]

### [ Seed Scarification: How to Scarify Seeds For Better Germination ][152]

[ [Dispelling seedling myths. Close-up of a gardener's hand adding potting mix to a young seedling
in a starter tray. The young seedling has a short green stem with two small oval smooth cotyledons
of a delicate green color.] ][153]

[Seeds][154]

### [ 7 Seedling Myths to Stop Believing ][155]

[ [Top view of a woman's palm full of seeds over large cell trays filled with soil mixture. Cell
trays for starting seeds are rectangular plastic containers with multiple individual cells, each
serving as a small compartment for germinating and growing individual seeds. On top of the cell tray
is a small garden tool - a spatula.] ][156]

[Seeds][157]

### [ How to Sow Seeds in Cell Trays ][158]

[ [A close up image of several stacks of seed packets. Some are banded together with a red rubber
band.] ][159]

[Seeds][160]

### [ Storing Seeds: How to Preserve Seeds for Years ][161]

[ [Close-up of small, evenly cut, moist cubes sitting in a tray, each with neat, compacted square
shapes, rich brown and textured, waiting for seeds to be placed inside, while the metallic pressing
tool rests on the surface.] ][162]

[Seeds][163]

### [ How to Make Soil Blocks: Tools and Recipes ][164]

[ [Violas with delicate purple and yellow petals growing vibrantly among green leaves in a garden
setting.] ][165]

[Seeds][166]

### [ 27 Best Heirloom Plants You Can Grow From Seed ][167]

# Geospace Technologies

## [Smart Water][90]

Our smart water products enable the global smart water utility and asset protection markets with
robust water-proof connectors and cloud-based remote shut-off valves. We serve utility and water
management districts, commercial and multi-family residential asset managers, and those designing
the smart water management systems of the future.

[Learn More][91]

## Geospace Technologies

## [Energy Solutions][92]

Our energy solutions technologies deliver actionable information for energy exploration and mitigate
risk in the new energy economy. Our leading seismic sensing technologies serve customers with
exploration products, reservoir monitoring, and energy transition applications.

[Learn More][93]

## Geospace Technologies

## [Intelligent Industrial][94]

Our Intelligent Industrial offerings harness technology pedigree with our deep-sensing capability to
deliver empowering, informative, and efficient tools to our global customers. Our sensing
technologies reach well beyond our roots in energy to improve national and homeland security and
surveillance.

[Learn More][95]

## Our Purpose

Geospace partners with customers to solve their toughest challenges, delivering innovative solutions
and sustainable long-term value to our key stakeholders.

[Learn More][96]
[Learn More][97]
[Learn More][98]

Learn more about what differentiates Geospace from other players in energy exploration, security and
surveillance, and wider industrial application fields.

## Why GhafDrip?

Our state-of-the-art drip irrigation solutions are meticulously engineered to empower landscapers,
farmers, and horticulturists with reliable, high-performance systems that promote sustainable growth
and long-term productivity. As the UAE’s leading manufacturer of inline PC and Non-PC cylindrical
emitter dripline, we take pride in delivering premium, Made in UAE solutions built to meet the
region’s unique challenges.

Premium Quality and Durability:

Crafted from high-quality 100% Virgin Polyethylene (PE) material, GhafDrip driplines are designed as
per ISO 9261 and ISO 8779 to withstand harsh weather conditions, including intense UV exposure,
ensuring long-lasting performance.

Tested and Certified Excellence:

GhafDrip emitters are pressure and flow tested by the Fresno State Center of Irrigation Technology,
California, a globally recognized authority in irrigation system performance. Additionally, Eplast
Industries is an ISO-certified company, ensuring that all products meet stringent international
quality standards

Water Efficiency and Sustainability:

With precise water delivery and reduced wastage, GhafDrip driplines are engineered to save up to 70%
more water than traditional irrigation methods. This makes them an essential tool for sustainable
agricultural practices in arid regions.

Easy Installation:

Driplines are easy to install thanks to their flexible design and durable polyethylene construction,
which ensures a secure, leak-resistant connection to fittings.

Improved Plant Health:

Provides consistent moisture directly to the roots, preventing overwatering or underwatering.

Water is drawn from a reservoir, tank, or mainline supply, ensuring a steady and reliable source for

High-quality filters remove impurities and debris from the water, preventing clogging and ensuring a
smooth operation of the system.

## End-to-End Plantation & Landscaping Solutions

**GK Nurseries & Plantations** offers complete turnkey services in **horticulture fruit
plantations**, **avenue plantations**, **agroforestry plantations**, **bulk nursery plants supply**,
and **landscaping services** across India. With 25+ years of experience in *contract farming*, we
cater to government, commercial, institutional, and private clients.

### Horticulture Fruit Plantations

High-density plantations of mango, guava, lemon, and sapota with expert agronomy. ROI-focused
**fruit farming solutions** with drip irrigation, pest management, and plant care services.

### Avenue Plantations

Execution of **roadside tree plantations**, dividers, campuses, and NH stretches. Suitable for **CSR
projects**, urban greening, and **climate restoration programs**.

### Agroforestry Plantations

Mixed cropping with **timber and fruit trees** on degraded or dry land. Encourages biodiversity,
improves soil health, and ensures long-term sustainability and farmer income.

### Bulk Plants Supply

We grow & supply quality nursery plants including forest species, fruit saplings, and shade trees.
Reliable partner for **landscape contractors** and **government plantations**.

### Landscaping Services

Custom landscape development for villas, institutions, and resorts. Our softscape & hardscape
solutions integrate **planting, irrigation, lighting**, and maintenance support.

### Nurseries & Plant Care

Our in-house **plant nurseries** offer fruit trees, ornamentals, and herbal varieties. We also
provide **plant transplanting, fertilization**, and disease control advice.

project terms. Buy-back assistance is available for selected crops and plantation models based on
commercial agreements and prevailing market conditions.
GK Nurseries — Vision, Goal & Values

# Integrity, Sustainability, And Customer Satisfaction
# Are at the core of our GK Nurseries & Plantations business.

Three pillars that guide our sapling supply, plantation services and aftercare programs — crafted
for homeowners, landscapers and commercial farms.

### Our Vision

With a focus on eco-first methods and community-led growth, GK Nurseries & Plantations aims to be
the trusted partner for homeowners, landscapers, and commercial farmers.
* Produce healthy, disease-free grafted saplings and seedlings.
* Promote sustainable & organic farming practices across projects.
* Enhance rural livelihoods by training and employing local growers.
* Supply end-to-end plantation solutions — from sapling supply to follow-up.

[Call: 9959900473][29]
Free site assessment for commercial projects

### Our Goal

To deliver measurable value through premium plant material, reliable plantation support, and
transparent pricing that helps landowners convert land into productive orchards and green spaces.
* Provide high-survival grafted varieties for mango, coconut and fruit trees.
* Offer site assessments, soil testing and customized crop plans.
* Run plantation & aftercare programs for 2–3 seasons.
* Enable farm-to-market support and buyer introductions.

[Email Us][30]
Bulk orders & commercial pricing available

### Our Values

GK Nurseries & Plantations is rooted in honesty, quality and continuous improvement. We prioritize
scientific horticulture, community well-being and environmental responsibility in every project.
* Quality first: certified grafts and proven propagation techniques.
* Customer-centric service: clear communication and reliable aftercare.
* Sustainability: organic inputs and water-smart irrigation.
* Community impact: local employment and grower training programs.

[CEO]

As the Founder and CEO of **GK Nurseries And Plantations**, my vision has always been rooted in
green innovation — to reconnect people with nature and foster sustainable livelihoods.

From humble beginnings as a single nursery, we’ve grown into a national movement — cultivating not

I deeply appreciate your support in this journey. Together, let’s build a greener tomorrow — one
tree, one farm, one future at a time.

– Shaik Saifur Rehman Ansari
Founder & CEO, GK Nurseries

GK Nurseries & Plantations | Contract Farming & Green Projects

## End-to-End Plantation & Landscaping Solutions

**GK Nurseries & Plantations** offers complete turnkey services in **horticulture fruit
plantations**, **avenue plantations**, **agroforestry plantations**, **bulk nursery plants supply**,
and **landscaping services** across India. With 25+ years of experience in *contract farming*, we
cater to government, commercial, institutional, and private clients.

### Horticulture Fruit Plantations

High-density plantations of mango, guava, lemon, and sapota with expert agronomy. ROI-focused
**fruit farming solutions** with drip irrigation, pest management, and plant care services.

### Avenue Plantations

Execution of **roadside tree plantations**, dividers, campuses, and NH stretches. Suitable for **CSR
projects**, urban greening, and **climate restoration programs**.

### Agroforestry Plantations

Mixed cropping with **timber and fruit trees** on degraded or dry land. Encourages biodiversity,
improves soil health, and ensures long-term sustainability and farmer income.

### Bulk Plants Supply

We grow & supply quality nursery plants including forest species, fruit saplings, and shade trees.
Reliable partner for **landscape contractors** and **government plantations**.

### Landscaping Services

Custom landscape development for villas, institutions, and resorts. Our softscape & hardscape
solutions integrate **planting, irrigation, lighting**, and maintenance support.

### Nurseries & Plant Care

Our in-house **plant nurseries** offer fruit trees, ornamentals, and herbal varieties. We also
provide **plant transplanting, fertilization**, and disease control advice.

What makes Heera Agro different from other brands?

Heera Agro delivers high-quality agricultural products directly to farmers, without middlemen,

Do you provide delivery across India?

location.

What payment methods do you accept?

You can pay securely through UPI, Credit/Debit Cards, Net Banking, and other trusted online payment
options.

How do I know which product is right for my farm?

Our product pages include detailed descriptions, and our support team is always available to guide
you in choosing the right equipment.

What if I face an issue after purchase?

We have a dedicated support team to resolve your issue as quickly as possible.

## Irrigation & Drainage Supplies

Horizon knows what you want from an irrigation supplies partner – the products you need, in stock,
at a fair price. That’s why Horizon prides itself on our expansive store inventory, featuring
products from Rain Bird, Hunter, Toro, Westlake, NDS, ADS and more. And our team is a knowledgeable
resource, making sure you walk out the door with everything needed to get the job done. Whether you
are retrofitting an irrigation system or starting a new construction project, Horizon has the
products and professional knowledge you expect from a distributor. And we have the irrigation
supplies stock you need to fulfill the order TODAY.

## Outdoor Living Spaces

Sometimes you need to go outside your normal scope of work to grow your business and keep up with
the competition. And that is just what Horizon’s Outdoor Living products can help you do. Low
voltage lighting, synthetic turf, outdoor kitchens, and hardscaping are all great opportunities for
you to improve your profitability and expand your service offering.

## Outdoor Power Equipment

Horizon is more than just an irrigation house. We offer a complete line-up of power equipment for
the maintenance professional featuring best-in-class manufacturers like Exmark, Echo, Greenworks,
Toro Siteworks, Kawasaki, Oregon and more. Every Horizon store has a large selection of the tools
you need – mowers, line trimmers, hedge trimmers, blowers, chain saws, plus everything you need to
keep them running.

## Landscaping Supplies

Horizon has the products and expertise to help you keep your client’s properties healthy and
beautiful. Whether it’s turf management, pest management, or soil health we can help you find the
right solution. Horizon has a complete selection of fertilizer, pesticides, soil amendments, seed,
sod and more.
